hero.headline:

hero.intro: I'm Mohammad Sabbir Hossain — an independent data entry agent focused on e-commerce product content and quality control, with a passion for turning ideas into practical digital systems using AI.

about.title: I learn the process before I do the work.
about.lead: Every client has a different workflow. I believe good work starts by understanding it.
about.body: My professional experience is rooted in e-commerce product content and quality control. I currently work with a luxury e-commerce brand, writing product descriptions and checking product information against specific standards. As an independent agent, I want to work with international clients on their own requirements: first understand the brief, review a demonstration, complete the training and then prove the workflow through a free sample task. Outside data operations, I'm a technology enthusiast who enjoys turning ideas into useful websites and custom CMS systems with AI-assisted tools.

services.name: Data Entry & E-commerce Operations
services.description: Accurate, guideline-led support for product information workflows. I adapt to your process instead of assuming every data entry task is the same.

services.name: Digital Building & Custom CMS
services.description: Practical portfolio websites with a custom content management system, planned around your needs and built with an AI-assisted workflow.
items: Zero mandatory monthly hosting or CMS fee

workflow.title: Client briefing
workflow.description: You explain the task, expected output, quality standards and working requirements.

workflow.title: Demonstration & training
workflow.description: You demonstrate the workflow and provide the instructions or training needed to follow it correctly.

workflow.title: Free sample task
workflow.description: I complete one sample task using the process you demonstrated.

workflow.title: Review & approval
workflow.description: You review the sample for accuracy, consistency and fit with your expectations.

workflow.title: Start collaboration
workflow.description: If the result works for both sides, we agree on the scope and begin paid work.

freeTrial.title: A sample before a commitment.
freeTrial.body: I offer one free sample task after your briefing and training, so you can evaluate my work against your own process before we start working together.
